text: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. [1] A prayer.
With my own voice I cry to the Lord;with my own voice I beseech the Lord.
Before him I pour out my complaint,tell of my distress in front of him.
When my spirit is faint within me, [AA]you know my path. [AB]As I go along this path,they have hidden a trap for me. [AC]
I look to my right hand to see [AD]that there is no one willing to acknowledge me.My escape has perished;no one cares for me.
I cry out to you, Lord,I say, You are my refuge, [AE]my portion in the land of the living. [AF]
Listen to my cry for help,for I am brought very low. [AG]Rescue me from my pursuers,for they are too strong for me.
Lead my soul from prison,that I may give thanks to your name.Then the righteous shall gather around me [2]because you have been good to me.
